title: KastiCraft Cobblemon x Create
description: Cobblemon and Create mod at once!
body:
This modpack has over 140 elements.

Mods:
  
  -Cobblemon:
    
    + add almost every pokemon into minecraft
    
    + provides a huge variety of items and equipment connected to pokemon
    
    + new structures
   
    + pastures anable you to employ cobblemon
    
    + new tools and much more!
  
  -Create:
    
    + new machines and tools added
   
    + new ways of transportation
    
    + compatibility with cobblemon
   
    + many improvements and others
  
  -Terralith 
    
    + makes the world much different, filled with over a 100 biomes

    + generates new structures

  -Artifacts

    + add 48 new artifacts

    + every artifact has different stats and craftings

    + stats and crafting were made for balance matters by the almighty creator (me)
  
  -Sopthisticated backpacks and Storage provide new wasy to store items
    
    + bakcpacks can be worn on your chestplate slot or accesory slot

    + backpacks work like enderchests but you can open them without placing

    + both backpacks and chests can be upgraded

    + create your favorite backpack by coloring them
  
  -Xaero's minimap compatable with cobblemon

    + view the world map you have discovered

    + create waypoints 

    + see your death cordinates as a waypoint
  
  -New decorations

    + chairs, armchairs, tables, cabinetes, and much, much more!

    + glass has variants: normal, scratched, empty, connecting
  
  -Exposure mod 

     + using cameras take pictures and make your photographic dream come true!
  
  -Gravestones secure your items when you die

    + destroying the gravestone instantly returns your items to your inventory
  
  -Simple voicechat allows you to speak in game with you friends (includes improvements)
  
     + pick your input and output divice

     + change players volume

     + voices match enviroment!
     
  -...and much, much more!


Looks and improvements:
  
  -Vibrant lighting
  
  -Many shaders that can be pick based on your liking
  
  -A few resourcepacks that improve the expirience
  
  -Many mods that improve your fps and overall performence


Datapacks:
  
  -U have an option to dissable lootr advancements or add experimental features
  
  -NONE of the datapacks are necessary


Important keybinds:
  
  z-zoom
  
  x-pick a startet/cobblemon menu
  
  c-scanner (when equiped with a smartphone)
  
  v-voicechat settings
  
  b-open backpack (if it's worn)
  
  l-battle logs
  
  r-throw/retrive a cobblemon   (if riding a cobblemon) dismount
  
  up arrow/down arrow-switch cobblemon in a party
  
  `-create waypoint
  
  o-waypoint menu
  
  shift + rmb-(on cobblemon) ride a cobblemon/give item etc.

  i-advancements
